# @loom/graph-executor

Distributed execution graph for Loom — fans a set of nodes into per-node executions (one writer each), dispatches them concurrently via the ExecutionDispatcher, records lineage, and joins the results

## Entry points

- `@loom/graph-executor`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
